facts.value: You must have been living in an EEA member state or Switzerland for at least 3 of the 5 years before starting your course.

You must be a citizen of an EEA member state or Switzerland, have official refugee status, be a family member of a refugee, be a family member of an EU national with permission to live in the State, or have been granted humanitarian leave to remain.
You must be undertaking a full-time undergraduate course of at least 2 years' duration, be a first-time full-time undergraduate, and not be repeating the year due to failing exams or changing course.
Free tuition fees are only available to people that do not have a degree qualification.
Level 6 and level 7 holders progressing on to Level 8 can get free tuition fees if they are doing a course in the same subject area.
